text: The rubble has piled up high in the entrance way. It is too heavy to move. You wonder if the water chip might have once been there. If it was, it is no longer available.
source_text: The rubble has piled up high in the entrance way. It is too heavy to move. You wonder if the water chip might have once been there. If it was, it is no longer available.

text: 碎石在出口处堆得很高。它重得无法搬动。你在想净水芯片是否会在这里。如果是的话，它再也拿不到了。
source_text: 碎石在出口处堆得很高。它重得无法搬动。你在想净水芯片是否会在这里。如果是的话，它再也拿不到了。

text: Big, heavy rocks are blocking the way to the room. You strain to move a rock, but it fails to budge.
source_text: Big, heavy rocks are blocking the way to the room. You strain to move a rock, but it fails to budge.

text: 巨大的石块堵住了进房间的路。你用力搬动一块石头，但它动都不动。
source_text: 巨大的石块堵住了进房间的路。你用力搬动一块石头，但它动都不动。
